name: AI Product Management Interviews
title: The AI PM round, drilled: designing with models, uncertainty, and feedback loops.
lede: A mock for the AI-specific round — 'design an AI feature for X', 'how would you evaluate this model in production', 'how do you handle hallucinations and edge cases'. We run a realistic prompt, then I show you how to reason about data, evaluation, guardrails, and the trade-offs unique to AI products.

faq.a: Whether you can design and reason about products built on AI — handling uncertainty, evaluation, data and feedback loops, failure modes like hallucination, and the trade-offs that don't exist in deterministic software.

faq.q: Do I need to be technical?
faq.a: You need product-level fluency in how AI systems behave, not the ability to train a model. We focus on the concepts interviewers expect an AI PM to reason about clearly.

faq.q: I'm moving into AI product — should I also book the career session?
faq.a: Yes, many people pair this mock with 'Breaking into AI & Product Management' — one drills the interview, the other plans the move.
